content:
As the Liquid Glass redesign rolls out to most iOS WhatsApp users, the messaging platform is testing another visual change, this time focused on the appearance of chat bubbles. Here's what we know so far.

A new, more rounded chat bubble design

Months ago, WhatsApp finally began rolling out its Liquid Glass redesign more broadly, after months of testing and refinement with selected users via TestFlight.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo spotted signs in the app's code suggesting that WhatsApp's chat bubbles would be getting a redesign. The site now reports that the new bubble design has started rolling out to some users running the latest TestFlight build.

Here's what WABetaInfo reports:

In addition to the change in message bubble shape, the new design also alters how media and links are displayed in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green border around them, making photos, videos, animated GIFs, and link previews look cleaner and more uniform.

According to WABetaInfo, the new look is currently only available to a small number of users running the WhatsApp TestFlight version, and there's no specific timeline yet for when it will roll out more broadly to all iOS users.
